name: OneLake shortcuts to on-premises data
description: Microsoft OneLake shortcuts is expanding to include on-premises and network-restricted data sources. With this capability, you can unify your on-prem and cloud data in OneLake.During creation of shortcuts to AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, or S3 compatible buckets, you will be able to optionally select an on-premises data gateway (OPDG) to establish connectivity.
